import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int Z = 100;
    static final int MAX_NODES = Z * Z;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = Z * Z * Z * 3;

    static int n, m, k, c_val, d_val;
    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>(MAX_NODES);
    static int[] capacity = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] cost = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] next_edge = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] to_node = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] visited = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] parent = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] edge_id = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int c) {
        int idx1 = adj.get(u).size();
        int idx2 = adj.get(v).size();
        
        adj.get(u).add(adj.get(v).size());
        adj.get(v).add(adj.get(u).size() - 1);
        
        capacity[idx1 * 2] = cap;
        cost[idx1 * 2] = c;
        to_node[idx1 * 2] = v;
        
        capacity[idx1 * 2 + 1] = 0;
        cost[idx1 * 2 + 1] = -c;
        to_node[idx1 * 2 + 1] = u;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        visited[s] = 1;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visited[u] = 0;
            
            for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                if (capacity[idx] > 0 && dist[to_node[idx]] > dist[u] + cost[idx]) {
                    dist[to_node[idx]] = dist[u] + cost[idx];
                    parent[to_node[idx]] = u;
                    edge_id[to_node[idx]] = idx;
                    if (visited[to_node[idx]] == 0) {
                        visited[to_node[idx]] = 1;
                        q.offer(to_node[idx]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return dist[t] < INF;
    }

    static int min_cost_max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        int total_cost = 0;
        
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int flow = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, capacity[edge_id[v]]);
            }
            
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                capacity[edge_id[v]] -= flow;
                capacity[edge_id[v] ^ 1] += flow;
            }
            
            total_flow += flow;
            total_cost += dist[t] * flow;
        }
        
        return total_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c_val = sc.nextInt();
        d_val = sc.nextInt();
        
        source = 0;
        sink = n * 100 + 1;
        
        // Initialize adjacency list
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        // Connect each node at level 100 to sink with capacity 100 and cost 0
        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i) {
            int node = i;
            int to_sink = sink;
            add_edge(node, to_sink, 100, 0);
        }
        
        // Add edges from source to starting nodes
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(source, (v - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }
        
        // Add internal edges within each node: level j to j+1
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int from = (i - 1) * 100 + j;
                int to = (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                add_edge(from, to, 100, c_val);
            }
        }
        
        // Add bidirectional edges between connected nodes
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx1 = (u - 1) * 100 + j;
                int idx2 = (v - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                
                for (int step = 1; step <= 50; ++step) {
                    int edge_cost = c_val + (step * step - (step - 1) * (step - 1)) * d_val;
                    add_edge(idx1, idx2, 1, edge_cost);
                }
            }
            
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx1 = (v - 1) * 100 + j;
                int idx2 = (u - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                
                for (int step = 1; step <= 50; ++step) {
                    int edge_cost = c_val + (step * step - (step - 1) * (step - 1)) * d_val;
                    add_edge(idx1, idx2, 1, edge_cost);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(min_cost_max_flow(source, sink));
        
        sc.close();
    }
}
